# Where in Uganda?

> Free search for a village, parish, sub-county, county and district in Uganda.

Where in Uganda? helps people fill in the place names asked for on NIN and NIRA registration, KCCA documents, and school forms. Search a name you know, or start from the district directory and open a district, then a sub-county, to read the parishes and villages listed there.

## Browse

- [Home](https://uganda.winjo.xyz/): search every place in the directory
- [Districts](https://uganda.winjo.xyz/districts): all districts, each linking to its counties and sub-counties
- District: https://uganda.winjo.xyz/district/<district-slug>
- Sub-county: https://uganda.winjo.xyz/district/<district-slug>/<sub-county-slug> lists that sub-county's parishes
- Parish: https://uganda.winjo.xyz/district/<district-slug>/<sub-county-slug>/<parish-slug> lists that parish's villages

Slugs are lowercase and hyphenated. When the same sub-county name occurs more than once in a district, the county name is included in the sub-county slug. When the same parish name occurs more than once in a sub-county, the later page adds a number to the parish slug.
